provenance.paper_title: Hierarchical Few-Shot Imitation with Skill Transition Models
provenance.notes: Manual reconstruction of all three panels from a flattened source figure. All labels, mathematical notation, modules, arrows, trajectory curves and markers are native editable objects, with no raster assets. Source gradients replaced by close flat fills; font/subscript typography, curve control points and line/dash widths are approximated. Most mathematical labels are typeable text; the compact policy formula uses editable STIX glyph outlines with its LaTeX transcription retained, not a live equation field. Freeform routes are not semantically attached.
